content.text: The Taxable income row equals gross income minus the active deduction, floored at zero, and is displayed as whole-dollar US currency.

expected_answer.operand: max(gross income minus the active deduction, 0), displayed as whole-dollar US currency

content.text: Changing a calculator input propagates an updated estimate without an explicit submit action.

expected_answer.operand: a changed calculator input updates the estimate panel while the user is typing

content.text: Recalculation after an input change does not require a submit button.

expected_answer.operand: a submit button required to trigger calculator results

content.text: Recalculation after an input change does not cause a full page reload.

expected_answer.operand: a full page reload after a calculator input changes

content.text: With filing status set to Single and the standard deduction selected, the Deductions row shows $14,600.
With filing status set to Married filing jointly and the standard deduction selected, the Deductions row shows $29,200.
With filing status set to Head of household and the standard deduction selected, the Deductions row shows $21,900.
The Gross income row matches the annual income the user entered and displays it as US currency.

expected_answer.operand: the annual income value the user entered, displayed as US currency

content.text: The estimate panel shows the breakdown rows in this order: Gross income, Deductions, Taxable income, Tax liability, Taxes withheld.

expected_answer.operand: Gross income, Deductions, Taxable income, Tax liability, Taxes withheld

content.text: The estimate panel total is labelled either "Estimated refund" or "Estimated amount you owe".

expected_answer.operand: a total label that is either "Estimated refund" or "Estimated amount you owe"

content.text: Choosing "Itemized" reveals an itemized deductions input.

expected_answer.operand: an itemized deductions input after "Itemized" is chosen

content.text: Displayed calculator amounts use whole-dollar US currency formatting.

expected_answer.operand: each displayed calculator amount is formatted as whole-dollar US currency
